title: Soudarion Cortege vs Alembic Brigade
lede: Soudarion Cortege beat Alembic Brigade 35-8 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4, the biggest margin of these six battles. It took all three objectives in Round 1 and held at least two in every round, while Sepulchre Guard 2 held the west for three rounds and killed its way to MAN OF THE HOUR; the 10 VP round cap, not Alembic Brigade, was what held the score down.
result_line: Soudarion Cortege win 35-8 on Victory Points in Battle Round 4
deployment:
Soudarion Cortege (Player A, south edge, 248 RP) is built round two Lazarite Prelates, each leading three Sepulchre Guard: Lazarite Prelate 1 with Sepulchre Guard 1 at (9,12), Lazarite Prelate 2 with Sepulchre Guard 2 at (3,12). Three Covenant Levies filled the middle of row 12, a Jordanite Hospitallers squad sat on each flank, with the Staurotheke War-Shrine at (10,12) and a St. Barbara Field Gun at (4,14). Alembic Brigade (Player B, initiative, north edge, 248 RP) fielded four Muqatila Troopers, three of them led (Naqib 1 at (8,2), Naqib 2 at (3,2), the Rammal Geomancer at (5,2)), two Carpet-Bombers behind them, the Abna al-Dawla Guard and the Royal Alchemist.

Soudarion Cortege's Primary, LEAD FROM THE FRONT, pays for a CHARACTER in an Objective Area or the enemy half, and the Prelates walk with the Cortege's hardest squads. Alembic Brigade's STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION pays mostly when the enemy's Primary scores nothing, which against two forward Prelates it never did.

1.title: The Cortege takes all three objectives

feed.text: Both sides spent 2 CP on Double Time, Soudarion Cortege on Sepulchre Guard 2 and Alembic Brigade on Carpet-Bomber 2; the record says neither move needed it. Alembic Brigade used Matter Transmutation: Zi'baq Beads (SUSTAINED ATTACK 1) on Carpet-Bomber 1. Soudarion Cortege kept LAST STAND, Alembic Brigade BAR THE GATES.

Both Carpet-Bombers flew to the centre, (7,7) and (8,7), with Sulayman's Wind giving them ASSAULT. Soudarion Cortege answered with three Levies squads round it, Covenant Levies 1 at (8,8) and Covenant Levies 3 at (7,8). Sepulchre Guard 2 and Lazarite Prelate 2 marched to (2,6), on the west objective and in the enemy half, and Jordanite Hospitallers 2 to the east objective at (12,8).

Carpet-Bomber 1 and Carpet-Bomber 2 each shot a Levies squad for 6. Soudarion Cortege answered with Fortitude on Covenant Levies 1, and Providence and Blessing of St. Barbara for the St. Barbara Field Gun's shot at Carpet-Bomber 2, which still missed.
Soudarion Cortege took all three: the centre on OC 14 against 10 (3), the west (2) and the east (2), plus LEAD FROM THE FRONT 2. 9-0.

2.title: Alembic Brigade wins the centre back, loses everything else

feed.text: Each side paid 3 CP for Secure Objective (Alembic Brigade on Muqatila Troopers 4, Soudarion Cortege on Sepulchre Guard 2); neither decided an objective. Soudarion Cortege kept MAN OF THE HOUR, Alembic Brigade FOCUSED FIRE.

Jordanite Hospitallers 1 walked into the centre at (6,7) and five Overwatch shots took 6 off it. Muqatila Troopers 1 and Naqib 1 charged it; Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 charged Muqatila Troopers 3 at (5,8); Sepulchre Guard 2 and Lazarite Prelate 2 charged Muqatila Troopers 2 at (1,6); Jordanite Hospitallers 2 charged the Royal Alchemist on the east. Covenant Levies 1's Overwatch killed a Carpet-Bomber model, and the Staurotheke War-Shrine's charge failed.

Sepulchre Guard 2 hit Muqatila Troopers 2 for 12 and Lazarite Prelate 2 for 2 more; Sepulchre Guard 1 did 7 to Muqatila Troopers 3. Muqatila Troopers 1 destroyed Jordanite Hospitallers 1, and Covenant Levies 1 (8) and Covenant Levies 3 (2) shot back into them. Carpet-Bomber 2 shot Covenant Levies 2 for 10. Lazarite Prelate 1 cast Agnus Dei (6 Mana) on Covenant Levies 1; the Rammal Geomancer cast Sarab (3 Mana) on Muqatila Troopers 4, which the record prices at 2.45 expected HP kept off it.

Alembic Brigade took the centre on OC 26 against 11 (3) and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 1 for the Hospitallers it destroyed in an Objective Area: 4. Soudarion Cortege held the west on OC 14 against 4 and the east on OC 3 against 1, with LEAD FROM THE FRONT 2: 6 for 15.

3.title: A 10 VP round with 5 VP more left on the table

feed.text: Soudarion Cortege's third Secure Objective (3 CP, on Lazarite Prelate 2) changed nothing. Alembic Brigade paid 2 CP for a Rally Cry for Muqatila Troopers 2. Soudarion Cortege kept IRON GRIP, Alembic Brigade IRON CURTAIN.

Muqatila Troopers 3 and Muqatila Troopers 1 both fell back (the first to (2,8), inside the west objective). Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1 charged into the centre at (6,7), and the Abna al-Dawla Guard charged them. The Staurotheke War-Shrine moved onto the east objective at (13,8).

The Abna al-Dawla Guard's charge cost it 8 HP and three models against 3 off Sepulchre Guard 1. Sepulchre Guard 2 destroyed Muqatila Troopers 2 (6) on the west, its first kill toward MAN OF THE HOUR. Lazarite Prelate 1 cast Gloria (4 Mana) on Covenant Levies 1; the Rammal Geomancer's Khatt (5 Mana) EXHAUSTED Sepulchre Guard 2 and Lazarite Prelate 2 but bought nothing.

Soudarion Cortege held all three objectives (centre on OC 18 against 9) and scored LEAD FROM THE FRONT 3: 10 for 25. IRON GRIP and LAST STAND both completed, but the 10 VP round cap withheld all 5 of their VP (IRON GRIP still paid its 1 CP). Alembic Brigade scored 0, and its BAR THE GATES and FOCUSED FIRE expired.

4.title: Naqib 2 dies on Lazarite Prelate 2's counterattack

feed.text: Benediction healed Sepulchre Guard 1 for 3. Alembic Brigade's Secure Objective (3 CP) on Muqatila Troopers 3, standing in the west, is the one command of the battle the record credits with deciding objective VP (4). Soudarion Cortege spent 3 CP on Secure Objective for Covenant Levies 2 and 2 on Double Time for Covenant Levies 1, which it used to walk Covenant Levies 1 out of the centre to (4,9).

Muqatila Troopers 1 and Naqib 1 charged back into the centre at (6,6); Muqatila Troopers 4 charged Covenant Levies 3 at (8,8). The Abna al-Dawla Guard fell back to (4,6). Muqatila Troopers 3 and the Rammal Geomancer stepped to (1,8).

Sepulchre Guard 1 hit Muqatila Troopers 1 for 8 and Lazarite Prelate 1 destroyed it (2). Naqib 2 attacked Lazarite Prelate 2, took 2 off Sepulchre Guard 2 and died to the counterattack (4): Sepulchre Guard 2's second kill completed MAN OF THE HOUR (+4 VP, +1 CP). The St. Barbara Field Gun put 3 into Carpet-Bomber 1 and set it BURNED.

Soudarion Cortege held the centre on OC 19 against 9 and the east, with MAN OF THE HOUR 4 and LEAD FROM THE FRONT 1 (2 more withheld by the cap): 10 for 35. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY also completed with all 3 VP withheld. Alembic Brigade took the west on OC 12 against 10 and completed IRON GRIP: 4 for 8.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Soudarion Cortege's 35: objectives 23, LEAD FROM THE FRONT 8 and MAN OF THE HOUR 4. All four of its secondaries completed, but three of them (LAST STAND, IRON GRIP, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY) paid nothing because they completed in rounds the Cortege had already scored 10: the cap withheld 10 VP from it over Rounds 3 and 4. Alembic Brigade's 8: the centre in Round 2 and the west in Round 4 (5), IRON GRIP 2 and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION 1. Its Primary needs the enemy's Primary to score nothing in a round, and LEAD FROM THE FRONT scored in every round.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Sepulchre Guard 2 with Lazarite Prelate 2 (70 RP together) was the battle's best pair: 12.0 VP for Sepulchre Guard 2 alone (the west in Rounds 1 to 3, the Primary and MAN OF THE HOUR), 22 damage, and both of its kills, Muqatila Troopers 2 and Naqib 2. Sepulchre Guard 1 did the most damage (23) and with Lazarite Prelate 1 held the centre in Rounds 3 and 4. Jordanite Hospitallers 2 (15 RP) held the east for three rounds (5.0 VP) while the Royal Alchemist chipped at it. The Staurotheke War-Shrine spent no APt in any round, but standing on the east objective was its contribution (3.0 VP).

Alembic Brigade's best were Carpet-Bomber 2 (17 damage) and Muqatila Troopers 4 (13 damage, 4.0 VP, the Round 2 centre). It destroyed one unit, Jordanite Hospitallers 1 (15 RP), and lost three (51 RP). Naqib 2 died attacking Lazarite Prelate 2, Naqib 1's Muqatila Troopers 1 was destroyed by Sepulchre Guard 1 and Lazarite Prelate 1, and the Abna al-Dawla Guard's one charge cost it 8 HP to inflict 3.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The army or the AI?

Mostly the army. Alembic Brigade's damage comes from Carpet-Bombers and massed Muqatila rifles, and the Cortege soaked them with Covenant Levies while the Sepulchre Guard, the toughest squads on the table, decided the melees. The Caliphate's magic (Sarab twice, Khatt) made Soudarion's attacks miss more but never turned a fight, and Matter Transmutation's Kahruba Charge on the Abna al-Dawla Guard bought nothing.

Neither AI used its CP well: five Secure Objective commands (15 CP) were issued and only Alembic Brigade's Round 4 one decided an objective. Soudarion Cortege's Round 4 Double Time walked Covenant Levies 1 out of the centre it held to (4,9), with no objective there; the centre held on Sepulchre Guard 1 anyway. The cap, finally, shaped this battle more than any choice: Soudarion Cortege lost 10 VP to it and still finished in Round 4.

{{chart:attrition}}

Against the first playing

The first playing went the other way: Alembic Brigade won 33-25 in Round 6. The roll-off differed (Soudarion Cortege had the initiative then, Alembic Brigade this time), and so did Round 1. In the first playing Soudarion Cortege scored 2 VP in it and Alembic Brigade completed BAR THE GATES; this time Sepulchre Guard 2 reached (2,6) in the enemy half, BAR THE GATES never completed, and the Cortege scored 9. LEAD FROM THE FRONT counts a joined pair as one now, so its two Prelate pairs scored 3 only when both were forward. The 10 VP cap matters in both directions: in the first playing Alembic Brigade won with an 11 VP last round, which would now be held to 10. The presets barely moved (Sepulchre Guard 2 45 RP, was 40; the St. Barbara Field Gun 18 RP, was 25).

closing: Soudarion Cortege played the cleanest battle of the day: three objectives in Round 1, the Sepulchre Guard winning every melee they were in, and a Primary that scored every round. Alembic Brigade's ranged firepower could not move Sepulchre Guard off objectives, and its Primary depended on an enemy that never stopped scoring.
